goal: Support independently authenticated multi-source production receipts in the existing DesignFlow readiness check, without extra ordinary commit gates or changing database promotion authority
prohibited_actions: No database schema or data writes in this maintenance change
No manual production apply, foreign claim adoption, app merge, billing/visibility change, or unreviewed platform mutation
No user-provided SQL/shell execution or credentials in application manifests
No additional promotion engine or new scheduler outside existing GitHub Actions process
assumptions: Existing approved train and existing qualified single-source automatic promotion remain canonical. No new SQL executor, scheduler, reviewer tooling, source fingerprint gate or ordinary commit requirement.
Multiple PRs may legitimately implement the same still-open application issue; authenticate unique source PR and exact authored migration set separately. Preserve duplicate-PR/version/path refusals.
All batched production receipts must prove exact source map, native immutable artifact producer, source hashes, ledger and catalog. Never infer production readiness from schema alone.
Tracking/frontend require both original4648 and companion4673. Unreviewed/missing/stale/ambiguous proof remains blocked.
stop_conditions: Unverified credentials or artifact evidence refuses before dispatch/readiness
Exact source or target drift refuses; missing protected dependency remains blocked
Scope outside listed files requires a new prospective contract generation
